interpretation_issues.observation: The annex says public service sites must comply with WCAG 2.1 AA.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: Scope of public service sites and whether annex language establishes a binding legal obligation need legal review.

interpretation_issues.observation: A text-reader feature is explicitly described.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: Whether separate built-in text-to-speech is mandatory or technology-neutral alternatives satisfy the requirement is not resolved.

interpretation_issues.section: Technical annex, sign language and speech recognition
interpretation_issues.observation: The annex discusses sign-language and speech recognition features.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: It is unclear which user journeys, media types and service channels require each feature.

interpretation_issues.observation: The policy defines governance, a Digital Accessibility Officer role, compliance percentages and Digital Government Enablers indicators.
interpretation_issues.ambiguity: Whether the 2024 policy is a binding instrument and what enforcement follows a low compliance percentage or complaint is unresolved.

interpretation_issues.observation: The Arabic policy page and the English policy PDF are both published by official UAE sources.
